title: Multi-Tenant GPU Cluster Network Isolation & DPU Offload: BlueField-3 DPU vs. SR-IOV + Multus CNI vs. IB P_Key / RoCEv2 Per-VF QoS

workload_basis.noisy_neighbor_event: Tenant A AlltoAll Incast & Slow-Receiver PFC Pause Storm

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Un-Isolated hostNetwork: true on Shared Lossless Queue (or Software VXLAN)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern for multi-tenant clusters (PFC pause storm stalls all co-located tenants)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Multus CNI + SR-IOV VF + Per-Tenant VLAN Isolation (Shared ToR Buffer Pool)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Internal trusted multi-team K8s cluster with cooperative workloads

tiers.tier: Tier 3: SR-IOV + IB P_Key / RoCEv2 Per-VF Hardware Rate Pacing + ToR Dynamic Buffer
tiers.recommended_scenario: Multi-department enterprise AI cluster requiring strict RDMA SLA protection

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU / SuperNIC (DOCA VPC + Hardware RTT CC + PFC Watchdog)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Multi-tenant AI Cloud / Sovereign AI Factory requiring bare-metal zero-trust & <1% jitter
